The family of [[Gideon Hask]] lived in a '''house''' on the [[planet]] [[Kuat]]. After the [[death]] of his [[parent]]s, Hask privately grieved in his room during the [[Standard day|days]] it took his [[Gideon Hask's legal guardian|legal guardian]] to arrange his enrollment in the [[Future Imperial Leaders Military Preparatory School]] on the planet [[Vardos]].<ref name="Inferno Squad" />
